semantics.storage: One-bit level-sensitive D latch implemented using an always block
semantics.enable: Active high: q follows d while ena is 1; q retains its previous value while ena is 0
semantics.timing: No clock or cycle latency; input changes propagate through the enabled latch after procedural simulation scheduling
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No specified initial value; do not initialize q in RTL; simulation begins unknown until enabled with known d

verification.oracle: Directed expected values from transparent-latch and hold semantics, checked after settling
cases: Disabled startup has no forced value
Enable assertion captures each binary d value
Both d transitions propagate while ena remains high
Both stored values hold across disabled d transitions
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite command timeouts and testbench watchdog
verification.scope: Independent development testbench only; no official evaluation or synthesis

specification_ambiguities: Initial q is unspecified; RTL supplies no initialization.
Unknown/high-impedance input behavior is not specified; binary functional behavior is the verification target.
